{{Quote|We have a phase connector, but it's in the back room and has already been sold to a mining colony on Valashar.|Kazuda Xiono to Teroj Kee, while in the Office of Aquisitions|audio=XionoValashar-DangerousBusiness.flac|<ref name="Dangerous Business" />}}
A '''mining colony''' operated on the [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]] celestial body [[Valashar]] by [[34 ABY]]. By that [[Standard year|year]], the colony ordered a [[phase connector]] [[mining]] device from the [[Office of Acquisitions]] on the [[Trantor-class supertanker fuel depot|supertanker fuel depot]] ''[[Colossus]]'', though it was ultimately [[Theft of the phase connector|destroyed]] before being delivered.

==Description==
A [[mining]] colony was located on [[Valashar]], an astronomical object<ref name="Dangerous Business" /> in the [[Mid Rim Territories]]' [[Churnis sector]].<ref name="Appendix">{{GalaxyMapAppendix}} — Based on corresponding data for the [[Valashar system]]</ref>

==History==
[[File:OfficeOfAcquisitions-TheRecruitPart2.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Flix and Orka (pictured) sold a phase connector to Valashar's mining colony.]]
At some point by [[34 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{ResistanceDate|1|13}}</ref> the mining colony opted to place an order with the [[Office of Acquisitions]] establishment on<ref name="Dangerous Business" /> the [[planet]]<ref name="TG">''[[Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge: Traveler's Guide to Batuu]]''</ref> [[Castilon]]'s [[Trantor-class supertanker fuel depot|supertanker fuel depot]] ''[[Colossus]]'' for a [[phase connector]], a rare and expensive mining device used for [[drill]]ing and excavation. The store's proprietors, the [[Gozzo]] [[Flix]] and the [[Chadra-Fan]] [[Orka]], logged the Valashar colony's phase connector purchase in their stock database and kept the device for them in their establishment's back storeroom.<ref name="Dangerous Business" />

In 34 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> the [[Technician|mechanic]] [[Kazuda Xiono]] briefly worked at the Office of Acquisitions in the absence of its owners. Xiono told the [[First Order]] operative [[Teroj Kee]] that he could not sell him a phase connector, as the one they had in stock had already been sold to the mining colony. When Kee attempted to forcefully [[Theft of the phase connector|take]] the mining device from the store, Xiono destroyed the phase connector to prevent him from escaping offworld with the merchandise. Xiono later informed Flix and Orka of the loss of merchandise intended for the colony.<ref name="Dangerous Business" />

==Behind the scenes==
Valashar's mining colony was mentioned in "[[Dangerous Business]],"<ref name="Dangerous Business" /> the thirteenth episode of the [[Star Wars Resistance Season One|first season]] of the ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'' animated television series.<ref name="Insider 190">{{InsiderCite|190|Resistance Revisited|''Resistance'' Revisited}}</ref> The episode premiered on [[January 20]], [[2019]].<ref name="Disney Press">{{DisneyPress|wdtv=1|url=disneychannel/shows/star-wars-resistance/episodes|text=Star Wars Resistance}}</ref>
